Moonshot AI's new reasoning model Kimi K3.1 Pro lands at number four on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, just 3 points behind the top proprietary models.

Chinese AI company Moonshot AI has released Kimi K3.1 Pro, a post-trained version of its predecessor Kimi K3 with significantly more post-training compute. The model scores 55 points on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, an 11-point jump over K3 that lands it in fourth place.

Only Claude Opus 5.5 (58), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (56), and Muse Wonder Full (56) rank higher, according to Artificial Analysis. If Moonshot releases the model weights as planned by November 4, 2026, K3.1 Pro would become the highest-scoring open-weights model available. That would shrink the gap between open and proprietary models from 12 to just 3 points, assuming nothing else changes by then.

Alongside K3.1 Pro, Moonshot is shipping a variant called K3.1 Pro Highspeed that runs two to three times faster, according to the company. Both are available now through Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and the Kimi API.

Item Kimi-K3.1-Pro Kimi-K3.1-Pro-Highspeed
Input $2.00 / MTok $4.00 / MTok
Output $10.00 / MTok $20.00 / MTok
Cache Input $0.20 / MTok $0.20 / MTok

Agentic tasks see the biggest gains

K3.1 Pro's strongest improvements show up in agentic tasks. On the GDPval-AA benchmark, it reaches 1,846 Elo according to Artificial Analysis, 312 points above K3. That puts it just behind Claude Opus 5.5 (1,866) and Muse Wonder Full (1,857). On Terminal-Bench 4.0, Moonshot reports 65.7 percent, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2 percent) and barely behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4 percent). K3 managed only 13 percent on the same test.

Hallucination rates dropped sharply too. On Moonshot's internal Kimi Hallu Bench Hard, claim-level hallucinations fell from 23.4 percent with K3 to 8.3 percent, according to the company. Moonshot says this is a stress test, not a measure of general error rates. GPT-6 Astra hits 5.5 percent on the same benchmark, so it still has an edge.

On internal finance benchmarks, K3.1 Pro gained 7.2 points on Financial Modeling and 11.6 points on Financial Research. For general office tasks, the model tops all tested models on OfficeQA Pro v2, according to Moonshot.

Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro benchmark table. All results with reasoning effort set to "max."

3D modeling and coding

K3.1 Pro works directly with game engines like Unity, Unreal Engine, and Godot, handling both quick fixes and full project builds, according to Moonshot. On the BenchCAD benchmark, it scores 92.7 percent with tools, close to Claude Opus 5.5 (96.2 percent) and GPT-6 Astra (95.9 percent). Without tools, it hits 72.8 percent, nearly matching Claude Opus 5.5 (73.0 percent).

Moonshot says the model is strongest at parametric modeling of mechanical parts, architectural models, and configurable products. It can write and run scripts for Blender and CAD software without MCP connectors. The company also launched a feature called "3D Make" on Kimi.com that lets users preview, edit, and export 3D models.

Same size, lower prices

K3.1 Pro keeps the same dimensions as K3, with 2.8 trillion total parameters and 104 billion active ones. The context window spans one million tokens, and the model handles both text and images. According to Artificial Analysis, it sits at the top of the Pareto frontier. No model with a comparable parameter count scores higher on the Intelligence Index.

Token prices drop by 33 percent. Input costs $2 per million tokens (down from $3), output costs $10 (down from $15), and cache hits cost $0.20 (down from $0.30). Each Intelligence Index task costs $1.98, almost identical to K3 ($2.00), since the model generates 14 percent more output tokens.

Cybersecurity and deliberate limits on offensive capabilities

Moonshot devotes an entire section of its technical blog post to cybersecurity. The company says it observed that vulnerability research capabilities kept growing as post-training scaled up, because cyber-related content was embedded in the general mid-training corpus and related tasks were part of the RL environment mix.

For the open-weights release, Moonshot stripped cyber-related data from both training phases. On its internal xdev-bench-hard, which reproduces recently disclosed vulnerabilities in software like the Linux kernel, Node.js, and JavaScriptCore, the uncleaned version solves 90.5 percent of tasks. After data cleaning, K3.1 Pro solves 81.0 percent. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reaches 85.7 percent on the same test, while Kimi K3 scored 33.3 percent.

Moonshot says no open-weights model should push the absolute frontier of offensive cyber capabilities. At the same time, the company wants to gradually raise what open models can do, since they also serve defensive purposes like auditing legacy systems. Anthropic previously showed that even GLM-5.3, which scores 45 on the AA Index, can write exploits at near-Claude Mythos levels.

translation.html:
Moonshot AI 的新推理模型 Kimi K3.1 Pro 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数中排名第四，仅落后顶尖专有模型 3 分。

中国 AI 公司 Moonshot AI 发布了 Kimi K3.1 Pro，这是在前代 Kimi K3 基础上投入显著更多后训练算力得到的版本。该模型在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数中获得 55 分，比 K3 提高 11 分，位列第四。

根据 Artificial Analysis 的数据，只有 Claude Opus 5.5（58 分）、Claude Sonnet 5.5（56 分）和 Muse Wonder Full（56 分）排名更高。如果 Moonshot 按计划在 2026 年 11 月 4 日前发布模型权重，K3.1 Pro 将成为届时得分最高的开放权重模型。假设到时其他情况没有变化，开放模型与专有模型之间的差距将从 12 分缩小到仅 3 分。

除 K3.1 Pro 外，Moonshot 还推出了名为 K3.1 Pro Highspeed 的变体，据公司称，其运行速度是原版的两到三倍。目前，两款模型均可通过 Kimi.ai、Kimi Work、Kimi Code 和 Kimi API 使用。

项目 Kimi-K3.1-Pro Kimi-K3.1-Pro-Highspeed
输入 $2.00 / MTok $4.00 / MTok
输出 $10.00 / MTok $20.00 / MTok
缓存输入 $0.20 / MTok $0.20 / MTok

智能体任务提升最大

K3.1 Pro 在智能体任务上的提升最为显著。根据 Artificial Analysis 的数据，它在 GDPval-AA 基准测试中达到 1,846 Elo，比 K3 高出 312 分，仅次于 Claude Opus 5.5（1,866）和 Muse Wonder Full（1,857）。在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上，Moonshot 报告的成绩为 65.7%，高于 GPT-6 Astra（58.2%），仅略低于 Claude Opus 5.5（66.4%）。K3 在同一测试中的成绩仅为 13%。

幻觉率也大幅下降。据公司称，在 Moonshot 内部的 Kimi Hallu Bench Hard 测试中，断言级幻觉率从 K3 的 23.4% 降至 8.3%。Moonshot 表示，这是一项压力测试，并不衡量一般错误率。GPT-6 Astra 在同一基准测试中的幻觉率为 5.5%，因此仍占优势。

在内部金融基准测试中，K3.1 Pro 在 Financial Modeling 上提高了 7.2 分，在 Financial Research 上提高了 11.6 分。据 Moonshot 称，在通用办公任务方面，该模型在 OfficeQA Pro v2 上的表现超过了所有受测模型。

Moonshot 的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 基准测试表。所有结果的推理强度均设为“max”。

3D 建模与编程

据 Moonshot 称，K3.1 Pro 可直接使用 Unity、Unreal Engine 和 Godot 等游戏引擎，既能进行快速修复，也能完成整个项目的构建。在 BenchCAD 基准测试中，它使用工具时的得分为 92.7%，接近 Claude Opus 5.5（96.2%）和 GPT-6 Astra（95.9%）。不使用工具时，其得分为 72.8%，几乎与 Claude Opus 5.5（73.0%）持平。

Moonshot 表示，该模型最擅长机械零件、建筑模型和可配置产品的参数化建模。它无需 MCP 连接器即可为 Blender 和 CAD 软件编写并运行脚本。该公司还在 Kimi.com 上推出了名为“3D Make”的功能，让用户能够预览、编辑和导出 3D 模型。

规模不变，价格更低

K3.1 Pro 保持了与 K3 相同的规模，总参数量为 2.8 万亿，激活参数量为 1040 亿。上下文窗口为 100 万 token，模型同时支持文本和图像。据 Artificial Analysis 称，它位于帕累托前沿的顶端。参数量相近的模型中，没有任何一款在智能指数上的得分更高。

Token 价格下降了 33%。输入价格为每百万 token 2 美元（此前为 3 美元），输出价格为 10 美元（此前为 15 美元），缓存命中价格为 0.20 美元（此前为 0.30 美元）。由于该模型生成的输出 token 增加了 14%，每项智能指数任务的成本为 1.98 美元，与 K3（2.00 美元）几乎相同。

网络安全与对攻击能力的有意限制

Moonshot 在其技术博客文章中用一整节讨论网络安全。该公司表示，随着后训练规模扩大，它观察到漏洞研究能力持续增强，因为通用中期训练语料中包含网络安全相关内容，强化学习环境组合中也包含相关任务。

为了发布开放权重版本，Moonshot 从这两个训练阶段中都移除了网络安全相关数据。其内部的 xdev-bench-hard 会复现 Linux 内核、Node.js 和 JavaScriptCore 等软件中近期披露的漏洞，未经数据清洗的版本可解决其中 90.5% 的任务。数据清洗后，K3.1 Pro 可解决 81.0% 的任务。DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在同一测试中达到 85.7%，而 Kimi K3 的成绩为 33.3%。

Moonshot 表示，任何开放权重模型都不应推进网络攻击能力的绝对前沿。与此同时，该公司希望逐步提升开放模型的能力，因为它们也可用于审计旧有系统等防御用途。Anthropic 此前展示，即使是在 AA 指数上得分为 45 分的 GLM-5.3，也能编写出接近 Claude Mythos 水平的漏洞利用代码。
